item.title: European Lithium Unearths Significant Rare Earth Mineralisation at Tanbreez Project in Greenland
item.description: European Lithium (ASX: EUR) has identified wide zones of rare-earth mineralisation in initial assays from 2025 drilling at the Fjord deposit and Upper Fjord areas at its Tanbreez project in Greenland.

item.title: 1414 Degrees Gets Key Approval from AEMO for Aurora BESS Power Grid Plans
item.description: 1414 Degrees (ASX: 14D) has received a key approval from the Australian Energy Market Operator (AEMO) as part of its plans to connect the Aurora 140MW Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) to the Australian power network.

item.title: Weekly Wrap: Winning Streak Persists as Tech, Banks Drive Aussie Shares
item.description: ASX 200 rises 0.5% to 8,903 as tech and banks lead; miners retreat, with Capstone Copper and Catalyst Metals rallying on strong results.

item.title: Trump’s Failure Clear From Just Two Numbers
item.description: There are always plenty of debates about the success or otherwise of US President Donald Trump; however, you only need to look at two simple numbers to demonstrate his absolute failure, at least in the short term, on two key economic areas—trade and the economy.

item.title: Resolution Minerals Engages Tungsten Expert to Develop Historical Golden Gate Mine
item.description: Resolution Minerals (ASX: RML) has engaged the services of seasoned geologist and tungsten expert David Hembree to help advance development of the historical Golden Gate mine within the company’s Horse Heaven gold-antimony-tungsten-silver project in the US.

item.title: Australian Gold and Copper Delivers Strong Grades at South Cobar’s Achilles Target
item.description: Australian Gold and Copper (ASX: AGC) has reported strong gold and silver grades from ongoing drilling at the northern high-grade zone of the Achilles target within the South Cobar project in New South Wales.

item.title: Enegex Defines Large Aircore Target with Power Auger Drilling at Tougbe Permit in Côte d’Ivoire
item.description: Enegex (ASX: ENX) has defined a substantial new aircore drill target at its Tougbe exploration permit in Côte d’Ivoire after power auger drilling confirmed broad, near-surface gold mineralisation over a large area.

item.title: Riversgold Intersects Shallow Gold at Northern Zone, Secures $1m Investment from Mega Resources
item.description: Riversgold (ASX: RGL) has hit shallow mineralisation in 21 drill holes at the Northern Zone intrusive-hosted gold development within its Kalgoorlie project in Western Australia.

item.title: Caprice Resources Continues to Advance Expanding Murchison Portfolio with High-Grade Gold Hits at Island Project
item.description: Caprice Resources’ (ASX: CRS) growing ambitions in the Murchison gold region of Western Australia have received a boost with new high-grade assay results from the company's Island Gold project.

item.title: Trek Metals Returns Additional High-Grade Manganese Results from Christmas Creek’s Kuro Prospect
item.description: Trek Metals (ASX: TKM) has reported outstanding manganese rock chip results from the Kuro prospect within its Christmas Creek project in Western Australia.
